description: Gets a B2B SaaS or developer-tools vendor's companion Chrome extension through Chrome Web Store review and keeps it published - permission scoping, reviewer access to login-gated features, the Privacy practices tab, violation IDs such as Purple Potassium, permission changes in updates, rollout and rollback, publisher-account security, per-customer and enterprise distribution. Use whenever a vendor mentions publishing a Chrome extension, a Chrome Web Store rejection or takedown, the item limit, or white-label builds for customers. Vendor side only: not IT admins, Firefox AMO, Edge Add-ons or code. Do NOT use for VS Code or JetBrains extensions (use samber/developer-platform-skills@ide-extension-offering) or listing copy (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization).
